# Pop Up

Pop Up is the little earth-pony colt who resembles Russell, the Wilderness Explorer from Pixar's *Up*. He attends Camp Friendship alongside young Applejack and Coloratura. Fans recognized the Russell resemblance as early as November 2015.

[![Pop Up with his popcorn - Friendship Is Magic, Hasbro / DHX Media](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/59742c403a041155fa409ef0/1565838243801-D0SED49FLHG4TFPZ5AY6/524%2BPop_Up_ID_S5E24.png)](https://www.macintoshandmaud.com/randopony-of-the-week-season-five/2019/8/14/randopony-s5e24-the-mane-attraction)

- **Appearance:** Golden-yellow coat, dark brown spiky mane and tail, amber-brown eyes, scout cap, green uniform, red neckerchief and trumpet cutie mark.
- **Naming:** Pop Up is a documented fandom name, used by Macintosh & Maud in 2019. Its possible connection to his popcorn and Pixar's film is speculative. No official name or original naming event was verified.
- **Speaking status:** Background character with no verified individual dialogue or voice actor.
- **Appearances:** The Mane Attraction (S5E24, November 21, 2015). His appearance is canonical to the G4 television continuity. No additional appearances were verified. See the [foal character directory](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals).

## Important moments

- **Popcorn at Camp Friendship** - The Mane Attraction (S5E24). He appears in Applejack's childhood flashback, memorably holding a striped popcorn container while dressed as a scout. The scene establishes his recognizable design and connection to Camp Friendship. [Contemporary episode follow-up with screencaps](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2015/11/the-mane-attraction-episode-followup.html). Exact video timestamp unavailable.
